user.title: SB Scheduler
user.description:
Day-sets are named groups of dates — Workday, School Day, Trash Day — that schedules can run against. Pick a workday calendar now and Workday and Non-workday are created for you; you can add more day-sets afterwards under Configure.

The Workday integration publishes one (typically calendar.workday_sensor_us_calendar). Leave it empty to start with just Daily and Weekend.

abort.single_instance_allowed: SB Scheduler is already set up.

add.title: Add a day-set
add.description:
A day-set is a named group of dates. Start from the weekdays it can fall on, then narrow or widen it with calendars and dates.

Dates accept single days and ranges: 2026-12-25, 2027-06-05..2027-08-17

data.name: Name
data.invert: Invert (every date NOT in this set)

data_description.weekdays: Leave empty if the day-set comes entirely from an 'included' calendar, such as Trash Day.
data_description.exclude_dates: School breaks, institute days. One range covers a whole summer.
data_description.include_dates: Dates that count even when excluded — these win over everything else.
data_description.invert: Turns Workday into Non-workday without configuring it twice.
